main.description: A guestbook comment left on someone else's catspace page, written to the commenter's own repo via createRecord (PDS-assigned TID rkey) and rendered on the subject's /cat/<handle> guestbook. Written and read by catspace (https://catspace.bisks.net).

subject.description: DID of the catspace profile owner this comment was left for.

text.description: The guestbook comment text. No client-side length cap exists in the UI today, so this limit is a conservative guess rather than a mirrored constraint — worth tightening once the UI gains an explicit cap.

createdAt.description: When the comment was posted, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
